name: Stopping!!! 7: Omoide no Gakuen Seikatsu Hen
original_name: ストッピング!!!7 思い出の学園生活編
source:
Is an animated novel in which a man with the ability to stop time does whatever he pleases to an unresisting girl. You can enjoy the girls who study hard at the city's academy as they get more and more dirty.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ129346.html/]DLsite[/url]]
